answer.rationale: The 5x latency spike on write path coinciding with a release 2 hours ago strongly suggests the release introduced the degradation. Memory_b1 demonstrates that rollbacks cleared checkout error spikes without customer impact in similar conditions. Memory_b6 shows staged release gating catches regressions early. Verifying memory_b1 confirms rollback viability under peak load; memory_b4 verifies circuit breaker containment as secondary safety. Rolling back isolates the release as root cause, preserves writes (critical during settlement peak), and allows rapid recovery. Add_capacity would be slower to take effect during peak load. Regional_failover risks writes during rebalancing. Route_read_replicas doesn't address write path latency. This action is least risky to sustained availability while we have only one intervention slot.
